Original User Story: As a CSM, I want to be charged a fee once I am approved for Practitioner status, so that my certification status can be activated.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a CSM, I want to incur a one-time fee upon receiving approval for Practitioner status so that my certification can be activated promptly, ensuring I can leverage my credentials to enhance client relationships and drive satisfaction.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The fee must be clearly communicated and should not exceed $200 to ensure affordability for all approved candidates.
- The certification activation process should be completed within 24 hours of fee payment.
- At least 90% of newly certified Practitioners should report satisfaction with the activation process in follow-up surveys.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the fee amount is displayed transparently during the approval process.
- Track the time taken from fee payment to certification activation to ensure it meets the 24-hour requirement.
- Conduct surveys with newly certified Practitioners to assess their satisfaction with the overall process.

Original User Story: As a site editor, I want to post information in a trainers-only section, so that only trainers see it.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to create a dedicated trainers-only section for posting information so that only authorized trainers can access this content, ensuring that sensitive information is protected and improving communication efficiency among trainers by at least 25%.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The trainers-only section must be accessible only to users with trainer roles, verified through user authentication.

- Check that all posts display the correct timestamp and author information.
